hero.zh: 一只奶油白的原创小壁虎修理员，短腿、圆脚趾、蛋黄黄大眼，戴灰蓝围裙，抱着偏大的珊瑚红一字螺丝刀
hero.en: one original cream gecko mechanic with short legs, round toes, large egg-yellow eyes, a gray-blue apron and an oversized coral flat-head screwdriver

workbench.zh: 摆有零件托盘和小工具的木质收音机维修台
workbench.en: a wooden radio-repair bench with a parts tray and small tools

anchor.zh: 后景右侧一台大型灰褐老式收音机，带扬声器孔、频率窗和弯天线
anchor.en: a large gray-brown vintage radio on the rear right, with a speaker grille, tuner window and bent antenna

sidekicks.zh: 扶线的小线轴、从抽屉探头的橄榄绿甲虫、摊开电路图的小灯泡
sidekicks.en: a tiny spool holding its loose wire, an olive beetle peeking from a drawer, and a little bulb unrolling a circuit sheet

props.zh: 少量螺丝、接头和一两张画有线路的纸
props.en: a few screws, connectors and one or two circuit sketches

headline.zh: 两行手写英文 TINY SIGNALS
headline.en: two hand-lettered lines reading TINY SIGNALS

rules.zh: 创作「微小讯号」收音机维修台。小壁虎坐在前景偏左，双手握螺丝刀在低位检修一个收音机面板。后景机器与前景面板均可辨，三组配角各自分开，使用原创形体。
rules.en: Create Tiny Signals, a radio repair vignette. Seat the gecko slightly left in the foreground, using both hands to tighten a part on a low radio panel. Keep the back radio distinct from the front panel. Give each of the three sidekicks separate, original silhouettes.
rules.check: 查主动作与三配角是否清楚。

rules.zh: 单张约 3:4 竖幅。只在左上排 TINY SIGNALS 两行，其余区域只用无字拨盘和无字线路图。
rules.en: Deliver a single approximately 3:4 portrait illustration. Show only TINY SIGNALS on two lines in the upper left; use unlettered dials and circuit drawings elsewhere.
rules.check: 逐字复核标题、画幅与额外文字。
